SCOPE (verbatim from the parent's step 6, minus the fork collapse which the parent keeps): after the parent has collapsed `approval-activation.ts:178-180` into a single `commitAcceptedLegs(store, request, plan, extraLegs)`, append the policy-risk leg built by `buildPolicyRiskLeg` (apps/daemon/src/planning/policy-risk-leg.ts, parent's step 4) to `extraLegs` on BOTH the GENESIS and subsequent-approval branches when the builder admits it, and omit it (without failing the approval) when it refuses. `approvedBy` = the server-minted operator witness principal (`context.humanReview?.principalId ?? null`, threaded through a new `ActivationInput.humanReview`), NEVER the payload actor or the bare request principal. `subjectRef`/`subjectRevision` come from `readCurrentActiveGraph(store, request.projectId)` on THIS path only (parent comment-3493d27c explains why path A differs), refusing SUBJECT_UNAVAILABLE without failing the approval when that read refuses.
